column1: # Imprinting disorders caused by uniparental disomy (UPD), one row per chromosome or region.
# Read by bin/collect_summary.py (IMPRINTED_REGIONS holds the same rows; tests/test_collect_summary.py
# checks that the two agree) to name what a run of homozygosity over most of one chromosome could mean.
# start and end: GRCh38, 0-based start, exclusive end, the UCSC cytoBand.hg38.txt bands of the region;
# empty for a row that applies to the whole chromosome. A row with a region applies when a run on the
# flagged chromosome overlaps it. "-" is no known imprinting disorder for UPD from that parent.
# Overview: Eggermann et al., Imprinting disorders, Nat Rev Dis Primers 2023 (PMID 37386011).
